_source_notes.shot_clock.enabled: P0 placeholder, unconfirmed (scoping doc Sec.4.2, Sec.8.1): MHSAA's actual shot-clock adoption stance is unknown. This overlay currently just repeats the NFHS-generic default (disabled) rather than asserting MHSAA either has or hasn't adopted it -- do not treat this as a confirmed 'MHSAA has no shot clock' fact. Needs owner confirmation against the current MHSAA handbook (P6); if adopted, set enabled=true, length_seconds (30 or 35), and reset_offensive_rebound_seconds.
_source_notes.fouls.bonus_rule: P0 placeholder, unconfirmed (scoping doc Sec.4.2, Sec.8.1): this overlay repeats the current-NFHS 5th-foul/two-shot/quarter-scope rule from basketball/us-nfhs.json, but MHSAA may have retained the older 7th-foul one-and-one / 10th-foul double-bonus (half-scope) model rather than adopting the 2023-24 NFHS change -- genuinely unknown, not assumed. Needs owner confirmation against the current MHSAA handbook (P6).
_source_notes.timeouts: P0 placeholder, unconfirmed (scoping doc Sec.4.2, Sec.8.1): this overlay repeats the NFHS-generic allotment (3 full + 2 short, 1 carrying into OT) rather than a confirmed MHSAA-specific count, and does not assert whether MHSAA broadcasts use a media-timeout format. Needs owner confirmation against the current MHSAA handbook (P6).
_source_notes.defaults.timezone: America/Chicago is Mississippi's actual timezone -- a plain geographic fact, not a rules-book value requiring confirmation, included here for parity with football/us-ms-mhsaa.json's own defaults.timezone convention.
